sql_templates.description: Get recent FII/DII flows, regime history, and market breadth for the last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.name: recent_flows_regime_breadth
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_trade_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows),
recent_data AS (
  SELECT f.trade_date, f.flow_signal, f.fii_trend, r.regime, r.confidence,
         b.ad_signal, b.trin_signal, i.trend_signal, i.trading_signal
  FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f
  JOIN signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
  JOIN breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
  JOIN market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
  WHERE i.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50' AND f.trade_date <= (SELECT trade_date FROM latest_trade_date)
  ORDER BY f.trade_date DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM recent_data;

synthesis_guidance: ['Combine flow signals, regime labels, breadth indicators, and index trends to determine risk-on or risk-off context.', 'Provide actionable insights based on FII/DII trends, market phase, and breadth statistics.', 'Report if current metrics support position adjustments.']

sql_templates.name: fetch_insider_bulk_deals
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2' GROUP BY symbol)
SELECT ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, bb.deal_date, ss.technical_score
FROM signals.insider_alerts ia
JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals bb ON ia.symbol = bb.symbol
JOIN latest_stage ls ON ia.symbol = ls.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol AND ss.snapshot_date = ls.max_date
WHERE ia.alert_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days' AND bb.deal_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
LIMIT 100;

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus synthesis on actionable insights from bulk deals and technical confirmation.', 'Emphasize buy signals and accumulation indicators.', 'Use TradingView format for export readiness.']
